{{Quote|Picking up... there are dozens of ships out there. Silhouette is Republic Special Forces. Triumph-class.|An Imperial officer|<ref name="Repelling Invasion" />}}
The '''''Triumph''-class''' was a model of [[Shuttle/Legends|transport]] used by the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces Division]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Repelling Invasion" />

==Description==
The ''Triumph''-class was a model of shuttle used by the Republic SpecForce Division in order to transport commando units directly onto the battlefield, being able to carry at least two individuals. They were hyperspace capable and resembled the [[Fortitude-class assault shuttle|''Fortitude''-class assault shuttle]] and older [[Rendaran-class assault shuttle|''Rendaran''-class assault shuttle]] greatly. Similarly, these transports were also armed with a pair of twin laser cannons.<ref name="Repelling Invasion" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Republic is flying reinforcements straight to the Balmorran Arms Factory and bypassing our defenses.|[[Darth Lachris]]|<ref name="Repelling Invasion" />}}
Dozens of ''Triumph''-class transports participated in the siege of the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|battle of Balmorra]].<ref name="Repelling Invasion" /> Under the leadership of [[Grand Marshal/Legends|Grand Marshal]] [[Cheketta]], the [[Balmorran resistance]] had constructed a [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|hyperspace beacon]] inside the factory. Using the beacon, Republic reinforcements, consisting of dozens of ''Triumph''-class transports, managed to slip past the Imperial [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] defenses by jumping in-system almost directly overhead of the battle zone.<ref name="Repelling Invasion" />

Imperial forces, who had by then penetrated the outer layer of factory defenses,<ref name="Siege of BAF">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Siege of Balmorran Arms|Balmorra}}</ref> caught wind of this and managed to detect the incoming ships. On the orders of [[Darth Lachris]], newly appointed [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of Balmorra, attack [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] were mobilized in order to blow the transports out of the skies. Meanwhile, Imperial forces on the ground began destroying the factories landing pads and [[Guidance system/Legends|guidance systems]], in an attempt to prevent the transports from landing. Six ''Triumph''-class transports were downed before Lachris called in additional [[Anti-aircraft gun|ground-to-air weaponry]]. Despite this, a single transport managed to slip past the onslaught. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Sedoya Senn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] were the only ones to reach the factories [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] but were ultimately killed by an Imperial strike team on the ground.<ref name="Repelling Invasion" />
